conditions.
hero.body: How this site can be used, and how a note left on the page is different from reaching Priya.

sections.title: The practice
paragraphs: Divine Souls By Priya is a healing practice in Dehradun. The site describes sessions, courses, and charged pieces. It does not list prices.

sections.title: A note on the page
paragraphs: Book, enroll, and enquire forms confirm what you typed. Nothing from those forms is sent on. To reach Priya, call +91 7668648224, email priyasinha1809@gmail.com, or write on WhatsApp.

sections.title: A session or a piece
paragraphs: A session, a course, or a charged piece is arranged with Priya. The right form depends on what you are carrying. This site does not take payment.

sections.title: Links that leave
paragraphs: Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, email, the phone link, and the map open those services. What you do there follows their own terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: What the Divine Souls By Priya site keeps, and what it does not send on.

hero.title:
Privacy
Policy.
hero.body: What this site does with a note, and what it does not keep.

sections.title: What stays on the page
paragraphs: The book, enroll, and enquire forms do not store what you type, and they do not send it on. Leaving the page clears the note.

sections.title: Reaching Priya
paragraphs: A call, an email, or a WhatsApp message goes through those services, not through a mailbox on this site. Write only what you are ready for Priya to read there.

sections.title: Links away
paragraphs: Instagram and Facebook open in those places. This site does not follow you there.

sections.title: No tracker
paragraphs: This site does not run an advertising or analytics tracker.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.description: The Divine Souls By Priya site does not set advertising or analytics cookies.

hero.title:
Cookie
Policy.
hero.body: This site does not set advertising or analytics cookies.

sections.title: No extra cookies
paragraphs: The pages load without a tracking cookie. There is no cookie banner, because there is nothing of that kind to accept.

sections.title: What a browser may keep
paragraphs: Your browser can remember an ordinary visit so a page can open again. That is the browser’s own behavior, not a tracker added here.

sections.title: If that changes
paragraphs: If a later tool needs a cookie, this page will say so before it is used.
